chars.IMAD: IMAD: a young man wearing a mustard-yellow hoodie with a black phone-repair shop apron over it, dark jeans, white sneakers
chars.SAAD: SAAD: a rich young man wearing a slim white polo shirt with a thin red collar, beige chino trousers, a big shiny gold wristwatch, brown loafers
chars.GIRL: GIRL: a young woman wearing a long olive-green cardigan over a cream blouse, a navy long skirt, a light grey headscarf (hijab), carrying a small tan handbag

scenes.name: n1.png
scenes.scene: Inside a small phone repair shop in Casablanca with shelves of phone cases. IMAD stands behind the glass counter, SAAD leans over the counter grinning excitedly and points toward the shop window; IMAD looks surprised.

scenes.name: n2.png
scenes.scene: View from inside the phone shop through the big front glass: the GIRL walks past on the sunny Casablanca street outside, IMAD and SAAD in the foreground behind the counter stare at her, SAAD with dreamy eyes.

scenes.name: n3.png
scenes.scene: In the phone shop, IMAD raises a hand with a knowing smile as if he recognizes who she is, SAAD looks at him eagerly waiting for information.

scenes.name: n4.png
scenes.scene: In the phone shop doorway, IMAD pushes SAAD by the shoulders toward the street, SAAD resists nervously, sweating, shaking his head.

scenes.name: n5.png
scenes.scene: On a Casablanca neighborhood street with white buildings and a small shop, SAAD stands in front of the GIRL with a hopeful nervous smile, the GIRL has her arms crossed and frowns strongly at him.

scenes.name: n6.png
scenes.scene: In front of the phone shop, IMAD bends over laughing hard holding his belly in the doorway, while SAAD walks back toward him embarrassed with his head down.

scenes.name: n7.png
scenes.scene: Inside the phone shop, SAAD points his finger angrily at IMAD across the counter challenging him, IMAD stops laughing and raises his eyebrows.

scenes.name: n8.png
scenes.scene: Inside the phone shop, SAAD slams a thick stack of Moroccan banknotes on the glass counter, IMAD stares at the money with wide shocked eyes, tense standoff between them.
